summary: Pilot-only: compare bagged-ET screens with tuned GBM (honest vs leaky CV)
reasoning: Round 2 taught me: honest ET-importance-selection + RF reaches 0.766 on pilot (matches the sealed floor-selected-forest success), while GBM on the same screen is only 0.689 with my first grid, and F-based/leader-based screens honestly sit at 0.60-0.66. Next I compare screens (single ET forest vs bagged-ET frequencies, k=30/40, deduped vs not) under (a) honest procedure refit-in-fold with GBM tuned via a wider grid, (b) literal fixed-pilot-screen nested GBM (leaky, for reference), (c) RF reference. All pilot-only; heldout untouched. Expectation in reasoning: some bagged-ET screen + better-tuned GBM reaches honest CV >= 0.70-0.73; if no screen+GBM combination reaches 0.70 honest on pilot, I will not proceed to heldout scoring with this route but reassess (the route needs cv >= 0.70 honestly to keep the gap within 0.05).
